retired_requirements.reason: Compresses oversight objectives and proportionality, provider/deployer measure allocation, five distinct overseer capabilities and the Annex III point 1(a) two-person verification rule into one article-level abstraction.
Compresses lifecycle accuracy/robustness/cybersecurity, metric disclosure, resilience controls, feedback-loop mitigation and multiple cybersecurity obligations into one article-level abstraction.

migration_notes: Article 14(5)'s two-person verification requirement includes an express disproportionality exception for law-enforcement, migration, border-control and asylum uses.
Article 15(4)'s redundancy language is permissive and is represented as a permitted robustness measure rather than a mandatory implementation.
Article 42(3), as amended in 2026, can establish deemed compliance with Article 15 cybersecurity requirements for systems within Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 when its conditions are fulfilled.
For Article 6(1) systems, the 2026 Article 2(13) limitation mechanism may affect Articles 14 and 15 only where its statutory conditions and delegated-act mechanism are satisfied.

requirements.requirement_summary: Design and develop high-risk AI systems, including with appropriate human-machine interface tools, so natural persons can effectively oversee them while in use.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Human-oversight design of a high-risk AI system
constituent_propositions: design and develop for effective natural-person oversight

requirements.requirement_summary: Structure human oversight to prevent or minimise health, safety and fundamental-rights risks arising under intended use or reasonably foreseeable misuse, particularly residual risks remaining after other Section 2 controls.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Human-oversight measures for a high-risk AI system
constituent_propositions: address residual risks persisting after other Section 2 requirements

requirements.requirement_summary: Make human-oversight measures commensurate with the high-risk AI system's risks, level of autonomy and context of use.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Human-oversight measures for a high-risk AI system

requirements.requirement_summary: When technically feasible, identify and build appropriate human-oversight measures into the high-risk AI system before market placement or putting into service.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Built-in human-oversight measures
exceptions_or_qualifications: Article 14(3) allows oversight through this measure type, deployer-implemented measures under point (b), or both.

requirements.requirement_summary: Before market placement or putting into service, identify human-oversight measures appropriate for implementation by the deployer.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Deployer-implemented human-oversight measures
exceptions_or_qualifications: Article 14(3) allows oversight through this measure type, built-in measures under point (a), or both.

requirements.requirement_summary: Enable assigned overseers, as appropriate and proportionate, to understand relevant system capabilities and limitations and duly monitor operation, including detecting and addressing anomalies, dysfunctions and unexpected performance.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Human-oversight capability of a high-risk AI system
applicability_conditions: Applies as appropriate and proportionate for natural persons assigned human oversight.

requirements.requirement_summary: Enable assigned overseers, as appropriate and proportionate, to remain aware of the risk of automatically relying or over-relying on system output, particularly where the system informs or recommends human decisions.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Human-oversight capability of a high-risk AI system
applicability_conditions: Applies as appropriate and proportionate for natural persons assigned human oversight.

requirements.requirement_summary: Enable assigned overseers, as appropriate and proportionate, to correctly interpret system output using available interpretation tools and methods.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Human-oversight capability of a high-risk AI system
applicability_conditions: Applies as appropriate and proportionate for natural persons assigned human oversight.

requirements.requirement_summary: Enable assigned overseers, as appropriate and proportionate, to decide not to use the system or to disregard, override or reverse its output in a particular situation.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Human-oversight capability of a high-risk AI system
applicability_conditions: Applies as appropriate and proportionate for natural persons assigned human oversight.

requirements.requirement_summary: Enable assigned overseers, as appropriate and proportionate, to intervene in operation or interrupt the system through a stop mechanism or similar procedure that brings it to a safe state.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Human-oversight capability of a high-risk AI system
applicability_conditions: Applies as appropriate and proportionate for natural persons assigned human oversight.

requirements.requirement_summary: For Annex III point 1(a) high-risk AI systems, ensure no deployer action or decision is based on system identification unless at least two competent, trained and authorised natural persons separately verify and confirm that identification.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Identification output from an Annex III point 1(a) high-risk AI system
applicability_conditions: Applies to high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III point 1(a).
exceptions_or_qualifications: The two-person requirement does not apply to systems used for law enforcement, migration, border control or asylum where Union or national law considers it disproportionate.
constituent_propositions: no action or decision based on unverified identification
verifiers have necessary competence, training and authority

requirements.requirement_summary: Design and develop high-risk AI systems to achieve appropriate accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity and to perform consistently in those respects throughout their lifecycle.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity performance of a high-risk AI system

requirements.requirement_summary: The Commission must, in cooperation with relevant stakeholders and organisations, encourage as appropriate the development of benchmarks and measurement methodologies for appropriate accuracy, robustness and other relevant performance metrics.
applicable_actor: European Commission
governed_object: Benchmarks and measurement methodologies for high-risk AI systems

requirements.requirement_summary: Declare the levels of accuracy and relevant accuracy metrics of the high-risk AI system in the accompanying instructions for use.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Instructions for use for a high-risk AI system
required_artefacts: Instructions for use containing accuracy levels and relevant accuracy metrics

requirements.requirement_summary: Make high-risk AI systems as resilient as possible to errors, faults or inconsistencies arising within the system or its operating environment, including through interaction with natural persons or other systems, and take technical and organisational measures accordingly.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Robustness of a high-risk AI system
constituent_propositions: account for interactions with persons or systems

requirements.requirement_summary: Technical redundancy, including backup or fail-safe plans, may be used to achieve robustness of high-risk AI systems.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Robustness controls for a high-risk AI system
exceptions_or_qualifications: This is a permitted means of achieving robustness, not an exclusive prescribed implementation.

requirements.requirement_summary: For high-risk AI systems that continue learning after market placement or putting into service, eliminate or reduce as far as possible the risk that biased outputs influence future inputs and address resulting feedback loops with appropriate mitigation measures.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Feedback-loop risks in a continuously learning high-risk AI system
applicability_conditions: Applies to high-risk AI systems that continue to learn after being placed on the market or put into service.
constituent_propositions: eliminate or reduce risk of biased outputs influencing future inputs as far as possible
address feedback loops with appropriate mitigation measures

requirements.requirement_summary: Make high-risk AI systems resilient against attempts by unauthorised third parties to alter system use, outputs or performance by exploiting vulnerabilities.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Cybersecurity of a high-risk AI system

requirements.requirement_summary: Ensure technical cybersecurity solutions are appropriate to the relevant circumstances and risks.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Technical cybersecurity solutions for a high-risk AI system

requirements.requirement_summary: Where appropriate, include technical measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve and control AI-specific attacks and vulnerabilities, including data or model poisoning, adversarial examples or model evasion, confidentiality attacks and model flaws.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Technical cybersecurity controls for AI-specific vulnerabilities
exceptions_or_qualifications: Specific measures apply where appropriate to the relevant circumstances and risks.
Where the conditions in Article 42(3) are met for systems within Regulation (EU) 2024/2847, that provision establishes deemed compliance with Article 15 cybersecurity requirements.
